name: DynamoDB
subtitle: Serverless key-value and document database
creator: Amazon Web Services
description: A fully managed database with single-digit-millisecond performance at any scale, inspired by Amazon's 2007 Dynamo paper. You design tables around your access patterns using partition and sort keys, and it offers global tables, streams, TTL and transactions.

languages.youWrite: AWS SDKs (JS/TS, Python, Java, Go) and optionally PartiQL

concepts.explanation: Rows are items with flexible attributes.
Decide how data is stored and queried.
Many entity types in one table.
GSIs and LSIs for other access patterns.

codeSamples.label: JavaScript · AWS SDK v3

pros: Predictable low latency at huge scale
cons: Access patterns must be designed up front
Ad-hoc queries and joins are limited
Costs are hard to predict at high throughput

pricing.summary: Always free: 25 GB of storage. Then pay per request (on-demand) or for provisioned capacity.

surveys.source: Stack Overflow Developer Survey 2025, all respondents
